text:
One workspace for
every subscription cycle
Features, data flows, payments and operations
Customers and renewals live in spreadsheets. Invoices are typed by hand. Payments are matched from bank statements.
Renewals, failed collections and overdue invoices are difficult to see in one place.
Finance teams spend days assembling recurring revenue and payment reports.
One customer and subscription record connects the complete billing lifecycle.
SQLite stores operational records; server APIs power the React interface.
Razorpay webhooks confirm online payment outcomes.
A scheduled billing job creates recurring invoices and queues reminders.
Date filters drive the dashboard query; charts show revenue by month, payment method, and paid vs. outstanding.
Creates staff accounts. Manages products, variants, plans, tax rules, discounts, templates and staff.
Handles customers, quotations, subscriptions, invoices and offline payment recording.
Views only their own invoices, subscriptions, transactions, exports and receipts.
Server routes enforce permissions. Sessions use HttpOnly cookies; reset links are single use and expire.
Products store name, type, sales price, cost and notes.
Variants add options and price adjustments.
Plans set billing frequency, minimum quantity, availability dates and lifecycle permissions.
Tax rules attach to subscription lines and are calculated in integer paise.
Product, variant, quantity, unit price and tax are captured for the subscription.
Plan rules gate pause, resume, close and renewal. Changes are written to a history log.
Daily scheduler checks active, unpaused subscriptions.
Unique subscription and billing-period key prevents duplicate invoices.
Invoice lines, discounts and taxes are snapshotted at generation.
Unpaid invoices become overdue; email reminders are queued before due, on due date and after.
Authorized staff can confirm or cancel invoices, send reminders and download PDFs.
UPI, cards and netbanking stay on Razorpay checkout; Cycvera does not store card numbers or CVV.
Webhook HMAC verification and event/payment uniqueness protect reconciliation.
Offline cash and bank transfers can be recorded with date and note.
Refund events adjust the invoice balance.
20 per page, newest first. Filter by date, status, method, invoice, customer and amount.
Open a transaction to see its payment reference and download a payment receipt or invoice PDF.
Export the current filtered result to CSV. Customer API results remain scoped to that customer.
React calls the Node API. The API reads and writes SQLite. Payments arrive through Razorpay webhooks; billing runs from the scheduler.
A one-time seed command can populate sample customers, subscriptions and invoices for demonstrations. Seed rows remain in the database until replaced.
The app does not yet sync customer or plan data from an external business system.
Set admin setup values in .env and run npm run admin:create once.
Start API and Vite in separate terminals; open the local Vite URL.
Add Razorpay test keys and webhook secret; use HTTPS/ngrok for webhook delivery.
Configure SMTP to send reset links and invoice reminders.
Automatic charging / UPI AutoPay is not enabled. Actual Razorpay and SMTP delivery require account credentials.
What is ready and what needs setup

Database migrations · role checks · customer isolation
Product and plan workflows · invoice scheduler
Razorpay order and webhook handling
Transaction filters, CSV and PDF exports
Automated tests and React production build

Initial admin account setup
Razorpay TEST keys and webhook registration
SMTP credentials for email delivery
HTTPS deployment and persistent SQLite storage
Production KYC and live-key activation
Automated checks pass locally; live gateway and email delivery depend on external credentials.
